headline: Nifty 50 *extends gains* amid sector resilience
subline: Pharma and FMCG sectors shine despite mixed market mood.
hero_text: Nifty 50 rises for the fourth session driven by Pharma and FMCG.

why.title: Pharma Surge
why.desc: Nifty Pharma gained with no clear catalyst.

why.title: FMCG Strength
why.desc: Broad sector strength lifted Nifty FMCG.

why.title: Crude Oil Drop
why.desc: Brent and WTI prices fell sharply.

why.title: Negative Breadth
why.desc: More declines than advances across the market.

sector_reasons.Pharma: Led the market despite no specific catalyst.

bonus_text: FIIs sold Rs 576.2 crore, while DIIs bought Rs 2,797.27 crore.
movers_note_gainers: Eternal led the gainers with a strong rise.
